# requires: store
#
# The primitive nobody else furnishes: a listener is told that nothing has
# happened. Quiet arrives once the budget passes with nothing visible, repeats
# each budget while the silence lasts, and a change ends it. A lease renewal
# is not a change: it moves nothing a person can see.
submit A size=64 digest=good src=file
watch W 200
next W
next W
next W
claim A alpha 60000
next W
renew A alpha 60000
next W

# expect 3: changed
# expect 4: quiet [WATCH-Q1]
# expect 5: quiet [WATCH-Q2]
# expect 7: changed [WATCH-Q3]
# expect 7: A=running/0
# expect 9: quiet [JOB-N1] [WATCH-P2]
# expect 9: A=running/0
